typesense:top-rated.greeting: *Japan, the famous city of Tokyo. It's the year 2000, lots of gyaru, visual kei and other subcultures. Also, dangerous criminals can lurk in dark alleys, even if you're taking a shortcut home, maybe after academy, maybe after work... You can also have a lot of acquaintances, but that's up to you. You can choose any subculture and feel almost free! Without any complaints!
